name: Browser-based war games on platforms like CrazyGames/Playhop
description: This benchmark aggregates performance across diverse quick-play browser war games (tower defense, real-time strategy, army command). It evaluates fast tactical thinking, resource micro-management, and adaptation to varied combat mechanics in short-session formats.
reputation: Popular casual war game collections on major browser gaming platforms used by millions daily
notes: Category benchmark covering many short-form games; tests rapid learning and cross-game generalization of strategy skills

companies: CrazyGames, Playhop and various indie developers
